description: List all shared and personal macros available in your Zendesk account. Use when you need to retrieve, audit, or review the macros configured for automating ticket responses and actions. Macros are saved response templates that agents can apply to tickets. Supports filtering by access level, active status, category, and group. Results can be sorted by name, creation date, update date, or usage statistics.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing Zendesk macros.

access.description: Filter macros by access. Possible values are 'personal', 'agents', 'shared', or 'account'. The 'agents' value returns all personal macros for the account's agents and is only available to admins.
access.title: Access

active.description: Filter by active macros if true or inactive macros if false
active.title: Active

include.description: A sideload to include in the response. See Zendesk API documentation for available sideloads.
include.title: Include

only_viewable.description: If true, returns only macros that can be applied to tickets. If false, returns all macros the current user can manage. Defaults to false
only_viewable.title: Only Viewable

page.description: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: Traditional: `?page=2` (integer page number). Cursor: `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before). These are mutually exclusive - use one format or the other, not both.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of records to return per page. Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.
per_page.title: Per Page

sort_by.description: Sort order for results. Possible values are 'alphabetical', 'created_at', 'updated_at', 'usage_1h', 'usage_24h', 'usage_7d', or 'usage_30d'. Defaults to alphabetical
sort_by.title: Sort By

sort_order.description: Sort direction. One of 'asc' or 'desc'. Defaults to 'asc' for alphabetical and position sort, 'desc' for all others
sort_order.title: Sort Order

inputSchema.title: GetMacrosRequest

name: get_macros

GetMacrosResponse.description: Response containing list of Zendesk macros.

macros.description: List of macros returned by the API
macros.title: Macros

next_page.description: URL for next page of results
next_page.title: Next Page

previous_page.description: URL for previous page of results
previous_page.title: Previous Page

GetMacrosResponse.title: GetMacrosResponse

conditions.description: Conditions that must be met for the macro to be available
conditions.title: Conditions

created_at.description: Timestamp when the macro was created
created_at.title: Created At

created_by.description: ID of the user who created the macro
created_by.title: Created By

default.description: Whether the macro is a default macro
default.title: Default

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the macro was last updated
updated_at.title: Updated At

updated_by.description: ID of the user who last updated the macro
updated_by.title: Updated By
